items.title: Online marketplace Gem Rock Auctions to offer the kind of sapphire seen at Christie’s and Sotheby’s
items.why: Online high-end gem sales point to growing affluent demand for big-ticket collectibles outside traditional auction houses.
items.summary_ai: Online marketplace Gem Rock Auctions plans to offer sapphires comparable to those sold at Christie's and Sotheby's.
items.take: Online high-end gem sales point to growing affluent demand for big-ticket collectibles outside traditional auction houses.
